top_signals.title: Abandoned vans lead deputies to $123K in Brooks shoes from BNSF boxcar theft
top_signals.summary:
Deputies traveling toward Ludlow found two abandoned vehicles matching descriptions from the rail investigation. BNSF police confirmed boxes inside came from a boxcar.

The post Abandoned vans lead deputies to $123K in Brooks shoes from BNSF boxcar theft appeared first on FreightWaves.
